methodology: Historical source logs are replayed unchanged under public commands until first down, guard mismatch or completion. Inner probes use authored waypoint alternatives with bounded startup timing, no run edits; successful added-landings have a real self-return, SAFE connectivity to the starting island and every roamer dormant. All accepted probes verified joint on/off and relabelled seats.
limitations: Inner routes are opening choices, not full clears or a proof of both-player cooperation. Historical failures are preserved rather than required. Bounded search does not prove impossible routes; seeds do not add enemy RNG diversity.
